items.title: [v0.30.0][BugFix][Ops] Fix GDN recurrent state indices exceeding the token count
items.author: chenxi-hh
items.excerpt: The CANN recurrent gated delta rule kernel requires len(ssm state indices) == T , where T is the number of q/k/v rows. Three call sites in vllm ascend/ops/gdn.py violated this contract: - Pure-decode path passed the request-granularity buff
